beats.title: From the Fort to Karawa
beats.boundaryReason: The party wakes in the pacified fort, investigates the temple and tunnels, inventories the recovered relics, and then makes the uneventful multi-day journey west to a festival-swollen Karawa.
dateEvidence: The session manifest begins on 1748-03-26, and at u0003 the party awakens in the temple after the prior night's rest.
At u0448-u0451 the DM estimates three or four days to Karawa, and the session manifest ends on 1748-03-29.

beats.title: Kisa Hears Their Report
beats.boundaryReason: Back in Karawa, the party reports its success to Kisa, learns of the Summer of Red Storms and recent attacks, and is directed toward Ikram and the temple.
dateEvidence: This follows the party's arrival on the session manifest's final date, 1748-03-29.
At u0518 the DM states that it is late afternoon.

beats.title: Stories at Ikram's
beats.boundaryReason: The party enters the bustling caravanserai, where Ikram identifies Arcus and shares news of artifacts, attacked herders, and the festival's coming competitions.
dateEvidence: The visit follows directly from the late-afternoon meeting with Kisa on 1748-03-29.
At u0784 the DM describes people sitting outside in the afternoon.

beats.title: Maps and Jasu's Clues
beats.boundaryReason: After reviewing what they know about Arcus and the region, the party visits Jasu and learns about the explorer's silvered spearpoints and interest in Great War artifacts.
dateEvidence: This continues the same visit to Karawa on 1748-03-29 without a rest or day transition.
At u1067 the DM says it is getting toward dinnertime, and at u1365 Jasu is preparing to head in for dinner.

beats.title: The Charmhearts' Troubling Secret
beats.boundaryReason: The party visits Bree Charmheart's camp, where her guarded reception gives way to an alarming encounter with a disheveled halfling who speaks ecstatically of a consuming master.
dateEvidence: The party leaves Jasu and immediately walks to the nearby halfling camp on 1748-03-29.
At u1555 the halflings are gathered around a fire cooking dinner.

beats.title: Meditation Interrupted
beats.boundaryReason: Delwath, Seeker, and Wellby attempt an overnight vigil at the oasis until Candrosa interrupts them and sends Wellby to collect a drunken Kenzo from Ikram's.
dateEvidence: At u1777-u1778 the group establishes that it is dinnertime on the same day.
At u1931-u1932 the DM places Candrosa's arrival late at night, around 10:30 or 11:00 p.m.

beats.title: Shakun's Protection Fails
beats.boundaryReason: Inside the Temple of Shakun, Candrosa tests the party's intentions, reveals that Shakun's border protections are failing, and asks them to help defend Dunmar.
dateEvidence: This continues directly from Candrosa's late-night summons on 1748-03-29.
The session ends when Candrosa sends the party to rest and promises to continue in the morning.
